author: Jongh
body:
Hey guys, I'm Jongh, and I'm LFT. I'm one of those ocn kids.

  • Kills - 528
  • Deaths - 553
  • PVP Ratio - 0.9547
  • Position - Midline/Rusher
  • Secondary Position (Optional) - Sky?
  • Bridging Experience - Ninja, ninja staircase
  • Cannon Experience - couple of basic icarus, whiskey
  • Skype - hukyunity, online pretty much all day long as I have the mobile app when not on computer.
  • Active: I can usually come on anytime in the afternoon after 5pm.
  • How you can benefit the team - My sword/bow is ok, rushing is ok by OCN standards, I'll be able to come out for scrims the vast majority of the time. Willing to practice for the team and improve as long as the team is somewhat active.
  • Timezone - I live on West Coast of the Usa, not sure what timezone that is.
  • Misc: I'd say my block placement is very good.
As a sidenote, I come from OCN, I have about 15 days clocked on there on Jongh and my old account, Jonghoweon. My k/d on here is pretty bad because on Avicus I'll just straight rush and screw around every time.
